# What does a hire really cost me?

> Free UK employer cost calculator: salary plus 15% employer National Insurance, workplace pension, Employment Allowance, equipment and recruitment. See the true monthly and first-year cost of a hire, and what a budget buys. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
